transcripts.intent: The I05 channel lost with a terminal but unsealed action is peer failure: the generation and maintenance are HELD
WRITE_BEGIN repeated in the owning session polls without a second drain or record
A second session cannot open while the first is connected, even to read status
R1 probe PA: a writer peer deviation whose records both fail after a clean close is HELD in memory; the failure marker makes the restart HELD and the rebuilt generation opens no maintenance
R1 probe PA2: a clean restart of a CLOSED generation also opens no maintenance (a rebuilt generation never does)
R2 and W02f: ValidatingAdmissionPolicy and binding writes are refused as sealed; they do not consume write IDs
R4: the writer's channel ends while a write is outstanding: the write is recorded IO_AMBIGUOUS before the session and maintenance end; a late outcome is not relayed
R4: a writer peer deviation while a write is outstanding: the abort is recorded before the invalidation and the session end
R4: the broker's RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED while a write is outstanding holds the generation; the write's outcome is still recorded and relayed, later writes are refused
R4: a storage failure while a write is outstanding holds the generation (failure marker); the outcome is recorded once storage works
R4: a writer frame while its WRITE_OBJECT awaits the response breaks lockstep: fatal, the write aborted IO_AMBIGUOUS
R5: a rejected write (409) reports no observed object metadata
R5: requestDigest is the digest of the canonical {head, bodyDigest} of the rendered request
R7: WRITE_BEGIN reports an armed action the storage-failure path denied when DRAIN_STARTED fails

transcripts.intent: W02b-F V2: OPEN is a point-in-time answer: an I05 channel loss after OPEN holds the maintenance
R4: the upstream exchange of a write is lost: IO_AMBIGUOUS, relayed to the writer, maintenance HELD

W2: the gate's bound on a write's upstream exchange expires: the exchange is aborted, the write is recorded IO_AMBIGUOUS {aborted: UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT} and that outcome is relayed; the maintenance is HELD
W3: a WRITE_BEGIN whose MAINT_REQUESTED record fails is refused STORAGE_FAILURE; the armed action the storage-failure path denied is reported only through I05 ACTION_OUTCOME
W2: a restart after WRITE_END keeps the recorded MAINT_ENDED reason (WRITE_END)
W2: a restart while the maintenance is open and not ended reports GATE_RESTART
